lines.text: This program does the same thing seven thousand times in ten seconds. Watch the memory.
Each time it asks for sixty-four kilobytes and writes into them. In one version I give the block back with free. In the other, I forgot.
With the free, memory stays at two megabytes from start to finish. Without it, in ten seconds it goes past four hundred and ninety megabytes.
And it keeps climbing: forty-two megabytes in the first second, four hundred and fifty-seven in the tenth.
Same code, one free less. Where does that memory go? Comment below. Code in the description.
